definition: The Arcade Learning Environment benchmark of Atari 2600 games, where DQN first showed deep RL reaching human-level play from pixels.
details: The Arcade Learning Environment benchmark of Atari 2600 games, where DQN first showed deep RL reaching human-level play from pixels.

explainer.lead: Atari Games refers here to the Arcade Learning Environment, a benchmark built around Atari 2600 games. It matters because DQN used it to show that deep reinforcement learning could reach human-level play directly from game pixels.

tiers.eli5: Imagine giving a computer a stack of video games and letting it learn by watching the screen and trying moves. The Arcade Learning Environment is the shared test ground for that challenge. DQN showed that a computer could learn to play this way and reach human-level performance.
tiers.practitioner: Use the Arcade Learning Environment to evaluate deep reinforcement-learning agents on Atari 2600 games from pixel observations. DQN is the landmark example of this setting. Do not treat strong benchmark play as evidence that an agent can handle every reinforcement-learning problem.
tiers.paperLevel: The benchmark couples Atari 2600 games through the Arcade Learning Environment, with game pixels serving as the agent's observations. DQN demonstrated deep reinforcement learning reaching human-level play from these pixel inputs. The result concerns performance on this game benchmark, not general competence across reinforcement-learning tasks.

explainer.example: A DQN agent is given the pixels from an Atari 2600 game and learns through repeated play. Its learned playing ability is then assessed within the Arcade Learning Environment benchmark, where DQN demonstrated human-level play.

usedIn.name: DQN
usedIn.detail: Demonstrated deep reinforcement learning reaching human-level Atari play from pixels.

usedIn.name: Deep reinforcement-learning research
usedIn.detail: Uses the Arcade Learning Environment as a shared benchmark for learning Atari 2600 games.

explainer.measures: It measures how well reinforcement-learning agents learn to play Atari 2600 games through the Arcade Learning Environment, using pixels as input. Its landmark result was DQN reaching human-level play.
explainer.typicalResults: DQN is the defining result: deep reinforcement learning reached human-level play from pixels on this benchmark.
caveats: Atari Games here means the benchmark setting, not merely a collection of games.
Human-level play does not imply general intelligence.
The result does not cover every reinforcement-learning task.
